snippet.title: STICKER/BALL Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537690/_STICKERBALL/

I am so excited to announce that STICKER/BALL will be yours on May 4th!

Here’s all you need to know before getting stuck in on May 4th:
🎾Fire balls
🎲Hit dice
🔢Earn points 
🍀Add stickers
☄️Trigger crazy combos
🤯Enjoy the chaos!

Be sure to wishlist STICKER/BALL if you haven’t already so you can be notified the MINUTE the game drops!

I can’t wait to share the full game with you all! 

Bilge
